# Required audit supplement for research chats (AUDIT-v1)

Read AUDIT_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md at the event's pinned release as well as the unchanged
v24.15 profile/kit/briefs. The generated packet includes the pinned protocol and
dated reader-access rows; a previous upload without this supplement is insufficient.

- Do your assigned role. L1-L4/L6 return evidence; L5 alone prices supported lines.
- L1: identify material returns/absences and precise lineup/minutes uncertainty.
  A named risk needs measured exact-scope with/without pricing by L5, or UNPRICED
  plus separate labelled sensitivities. Do not invent player effect sizes.
- L2: show true sample n/coverage and opponent strength behind an underdog-plus
  comparison. Raw season margins and simulation count are insufficient.
- L3: verify exact competition, native event/date, home/away, schedule and endpoints.
  Adjacent-day rematches must not share an identity or result.
- L4: check collector lineage and important claims; agreement is not independence.
- L5: use the admitted reference and effect rows; disclose uncertainty. Unsupported
  subjective scenarios and retired v4.12 outputs stay outside primary pricing.
- Before opening any source, check the current actual-reader/path decision. Refuse
  blocked/unknown/expired decisions; use an allowed alternative. Prefer stats-only
  pages and disclose sporting-field use/exposure on any permitted mixed page.
- Keep separate actual request, research start/end, observation and save clocks.
  Keep the final cumulative mini with balanced card markers in your own namespace.
  Deliver HANDOVER.csv and every member; scripts and indexes cannot replace a card.

Do not claim hashes prove publication, a small settled batch proves an adjustment,
or agreement between repeated full cards proves predictive improvement. Missing
evidence remains missing. Chat research is not a repository-issued forecast.
